name: Fire Exit Sign
instruction: Design a fire exit sign. The sign should be rectangular with the words "FIRE EXIT" prominently displayed in the center. Include a running figure and an arrow pointing to the left. Ensure the text and symbols are clearly visible.

Shape accuracy: The sign is rectangular in shape.
The dimensions of the rectangle are appropriate for visibility.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The words on the sign are proportionate to the sign.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The text is centered within the rectangle.
The running figure is positioned appropriately relative to the text.
The arrow is placed to the left of the running figure.
Object distance and contact: There is adequate spacing between the text, running figure, and arrow.
The elements do not overlap, ensuring clarity.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The design follows the instruction without deviations.
